name: Click2Chat Whatsapp Connector
description: Conecta sessões do WhatsApp Web desta máquina ao Click2Chat, uma por container.

gecko.//min: 128 would do for content_scripts `world: "MAIN"`; data_collection_permissions needs 140 on desktop and 142 on Android. Raising the floor to 142 is free — the target machines are ours to provision — and keeps the lint clean.
gecko.//: Declared honestly: this extension relays WhatsApp conversations and the account's own phone number to the Click2Chat gateway. Understating it would be both a review risk and a lie to the operator installing it.
